sourceEvidence: Simulated SteeringWheelBlock has a Y rotation axis; floor mounting exposes its shaft downward and the north-facing floor state generates negative shaft RPM for a positive logical steering command.
Create 6.0.10 GearboxBlock exposes shafts on faces whose axis differs from the gearbox AXIS.
Create 6.0.10 RotationPropagator gearbox sign conversion is source-face and output-direction dependent; v0.18 therefore searches and validates sign as part of route state.
Create resources are exact: create:shaft, create:gearbox, and create:cogwheel.
The accepted v0.17 tail interface is retained at drive cog [18,3,1] adjacent to the UP-facing Swivel at [18,3,0].

runtimeObligations.method: assemble the route-modified exact-stack aircraft and require all routed parent-main cells plus the accepted propeller/rudder payloads to transfer into the primary Sable body
command the pilot-adjacent Steering Wheel and measure 16-RPM magnitude plus the compiler-predicted sign at the aft drive cog and Swivel hidden extra cog
command a finite rudder deflection through the complete cockpit route, release/hold, explicitly command zero, and verify the physical rudder returns near neutral
measure Sable mass and center of mass after all production-route blocks are part of the primary body
